about.title: J, K, L
about.length_note: About 10 minutes: three letters, one look-alike to sort out, and a short recall of A to I. You can pause after any letter and come back later.

say.text: Welcome back, {name}, and welcome to anyone joining us. Today we meet three letters: J, K and L. Go at your own pace. You can pause any time.
First, a warm-up with the letters you already know, A to I. There's no pressure. If one feels fuzzy, that's fine. It comes back with practice.

show.text: A B C D E F G H I

say.text: Here's a quick one. Which letter does the word apple start with?

ask.q: Which letter does the word apple start with?
ask.why: Apple starts with A, which says its short sound: a, a, apple.

say.text: Now our first new letter. This is J. Its name is jay. Say it with me: jay.

show.text: Upper case: J | Lower case: j

say.text: J makes the sound juh, like at the start of jam. Juh, juh, jam. Look at the small j. It has a dot on top, and its tail curls down below the line. The big J curls the same way, but it has no dot.

show.text: J, j: juh, as in jam

ask.q: Which word starts with the juh sound?
ask.why: Jam starts with juh, the sound of J.

say.text: Next is K. Its name is kay. Say it: kay. The sound is kuh, like the start of keys. Kuh, kuh, keys.

show.text: Upper case: K | Lower case: k

say.text: Here is a grown-up word too: kitchen. It also starts with K. Kuh, kuh, kitchen. Big K and little k have the same shape. The small one just sits a bit lower and is smaller. It's one straight line with two arms.

show.text: K, k: kuh, as in keys and kitchen

ask.q: Which of these starts with the kuh sound?
ask.why: Kitchen starts with K, which says kuh, just like keys.

say.text: Our third letter is L. Its name is el. Say it: el. The sound is lll, with your tongue touching just behind your top teeth, like the start of lamp. Lll, lll, lamp.

show.text: Upper case: L | Lower case: l

say.text: A grown-up word for L is letter, like a letter in the post. Big L is a straight line with a foot, like a corner. Little l is only a tall straight line, with no foot.

show.text: L, l: lll, as in lamp and letter

ask.q: Which letter has a sound like lll, as in lamp?
ask.why: L says lll. Lamp and letter both start with it.

say.text: Here's a tricky bit, and it trips up many readers, so don't worry if it does. A little l is a tall straight line. A big I is also a tall straight line. In many kinds of print they look almost the same.

show.text: Two plain tall straight lines side by side. One is labelled little l, the other big I. They look nearly identical.

say.text: Here are some ways to tell them apart. Look at the other letters around it. In lamp, the l sits inside a word with a, m and p. As a word on its own, a big I means me, as in I am here. And a little i, as opposed to an l, has a dot on top. Sometimes, in handwriting or in some fonts, a big I has little bars across the top and bottom.

show.text: 1. Look at the letters around it. 2. A single I on its own means me. 3. Little i has a dot; little l does not. 4. Some fonts give big I little bars at top and bottom.

ask.q: In the word lamp, the first letter is a tall straight line. Which letter is it?
ask.why: Lamp starts with the lll sound, so it is a little l. It does not have a dot, and it is not a big I, which would be a word on its own.

say.text: Now match big to little. Big J goes with little j. Big K goes with little k. Big L goes with little l. Say each pair out loud: J, j, jam. K, k, keys. L, l, lamp.

show.text: J – j: jam | K – k: keys | L – l: lamp

ask.q: Which little letter matches the big K?
ask.why: Big K and little k are partners. They have the same straight line and two arms.

say.text: Well done. You met three letters today: J for jam, K for keys and kitchen, and L for lamp and letter. Next time we move on to M, N and O. Come back whenever you are ready, and repeat any part as often as you like.

show.text: J, j: jam | K, k: keys, kitchen | L, l: lamp, letter
